# Avient Debuts Flame Retardant Polymer Technologies at Fakuma 2026 to Advance Fire Safety and Sustainability


##### September 28, 2026


##


*Avient will showcase new materials alongside its comprehensive portfolio, including healthcare solutions, flame-retardant technologies, sustainable materials, and aesthetic solutions at Fakuma (Booth 5104), October 12 – 16, 2026*


*To download a high-resolution image, please click here:*[FOR MEDIA USE ONLY](https://avient.stockpress.co/s/cb60c0ae)


**Key Highlights**


- New Nymax™ FR REC Flame Retardant Recycled Nylon Formulations deliver non-halogenated fire safety performance for electrical and electronics applications while incorporating 42% - 77% post-industrial recycled content
- New Maxxam™ NHFR Polyolefin Formulations offer UL 94 5VA flame rating at 2.0 mm, and both new formulations achieve a glow-wire flammability index (GWFI) of 960°C, addressing stringent fire safety standards across appliance and electrical applications
- Both new formulations help appliance and electrical manufacturers meet tightening fire safety standards while advancing sustainability objectives
- Comprehensive portfolio showcasing healthcare solutions, flame-retardant technologies, sustainable materials, and aesthetic solutions


**FRIEDRICHSHAFFEN, Germany** – September 28, 2026 – Avient Corporation, an innovator of materials solutions, today announced the launch of Maxxam™ NHFR Polyolefin Formulations and Nymax™ FR REC Flame Retardant Recycled Nylon Formulations at the upcoming[Fakuma](https://www.fakuma-messe.de/en/) international trade fair for plastics processing, to help manufacturers meet tightening global fire safety regulations. The electrical and electronics (E&E) and appliance markets face mounting pressure to replace halogenated chemistry with non-halogenated alternatives. The new grades serve appliance manufacturers, E&E component manufacturers, and material specifiers seeking qualified fire-safety performance. The company will highlight these innovations, along with a comprehensive portfolio of materials solutions, at the event October 12 – 16.


**New for 2026: Materials solutions that address the market shift**


Avient’s new technologies reflect the direction the market is moving — away from halogenated chemistry and toward high-performance non-halogenated polymer alternatives that help customers meet performance, regulatory, and sustainability objectives. Avient’s two new flame-retardant technologies address fire safety across multiple base resins to help eliminate the trade-off manufacturers previously faced.


“We often hear from customers who feel the tension between uncompromising fire safety and aggressive sustainability targets — and until now, they had to trade one for the other,” said Hermann Fuechter, Senior Manager, Global Strategic Marketing, Specialty Engineered Materials at Avient. “With these new formulations, we can offer manufacturers flame-retardant materials that can meet the highest fire-safety ratings, with recycled content built in for the Nymax FR REC grades. This is the kind of progress that helps designers build the infrastructure the world needs.”


**Nymax™ FR REC Flame Retardant Recycled Nylon Formulations** ([Click to view full release](https://www.avient.com/news/avient-launches-nymax-fr-rec-flame-retardant-recycled-polyamides-meet-rising-electrification-and-circularity-demand) )


Nymax™ FR REC flame-retardant recycled polyamide grades deliver non-halogenated fire safety for electrical and electronics applications while incorporating 42% to 77% post-industrial recycled content. The portfolio spans PA6 and PA66 resins with 15% to 40% glass fiber loading plus unfilled options, with a staged color expansion in development.


**Key attributes:**


- UL 94 V-0 rating at 0.8 mm, a GWFI of 960°C, and comparative tracking index (CTI) values up to 600 V
- Non-halogenated flame-retardant (NHFR) chemistry aligns with restricted-substance lists, and non-PFAS formulations anticipate emerging regulatory bans targeting per- or polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)
- Incorporates 42-77% post-industrial recycled content supporting OEM sustainability targets and can lower product carbon footprint versus prime flame-retardant polyamide


**Maxxam™ NHFR Non-Halogen Flame Retardant Polyolefin Formulations Achieving UL 94 5VA Rating** ([Click to view full release](https://www.avient.com/news/avient-s-new-maxxam-nhfr-polyolefin-formulations-achieve-ul-94-5va-rating-20-mm-enhance-appliance-fire-safety) )


Maxxam™ NHFR formulations offer appliance designers meaningful design flexibility to optimize part geometry, reduce wall thickness, and pursue metal-to-plastic conversion opportunities without compromising fire performance.


**Key attributes:**


- UL 94 5VA flame rating at 2.0 mm, addressing heightened compliance requirements for unmonitored household appliances under IEC 60335 and UL 60335
- Glow-Wire Flammability Index of 960°C per IEC 60695
- Non-halogenated chemistry that reduces the risk of corrosive gas generation during a fire event


**The Avient Portfolio at Fakuma 2026**


In addition to these new launches, Avient will showcase a comprehensive range of innovative polymer materials at Fakuma 2026, including:


**Healthcare Solutions:** Avient’s healthcare portfolio includes technologies for medical device and healthcare equipment manufacturers:


- GlideTech™ Formulations can deliver exceptional coefficient of friction (CoF) performance without using PFAS
- Trilliant™ HC Healthcare Thermoplastics for chemical resistance, enhanced toughness and durability, and UL 94 flame ratings
- Versaflex™ HC Thermoplastic Elastomers (TPEs) are formulated without phthalates, offering excellent medical-grade TPEs with chemical resistance and the ability to bond in healthcare device applications


**Flame Retardant Technologies:** Avient also has flame retardant technologies in nylon, polybutylene terephthalate (PBT), polyolefins, and TPEs, offering comprehensive performance for diverse applications:


- OnFlex™ NHFR Non-Halogen Flame Retardant TPEs can achieve UL 94 V-0 performance with excellent flexibility and low moisture absorption for automotive, electronics, and construction applications
- Flame-retardant engineered polymers with recognized UL 94 flammability standards, RoHS-compliance for use in electrical and electronic applications, colorability for aesthetic or industry color-coding requirements, and non-halogenated grades available within the Maxxam™ FR and Bergamid™ FR portfolios


**Sustainable Materials:** Avient’s sustainable portfolio spans a range of polymer bases, including TPEs, nylon, and polyolefins, offering customers a path to carbon footprint reduction while maintaining performance:


- Recycled-content technologies that can be formulated with 9%-100% post-industrial recycled (PIR) and post-consumer recycled (PCR) content
- Bio-based technologies containing 16–75% renewable plant-derived content, helping customers reduce carbon footprint while maintaining performance comparable to virgin materials


**Aesthetic Solutions:**


- Artisan™ Pre-Colored Thermoplastics, available in high gloss, created for paint replacement with excellent scratch resistance and ultraviolet (UV) stability
- Gravi-Tech™ Density Modified Formulations provide metallic finishes and premium aesthetics for luxury packaging and are also available utilizing recycled resin and/or filler


**Expert Availability**


Avient technical experts will be available from October 12 – 16 in Hall B5, Booth 5104 to discuss application opportunities and material challenges. Attendees interested in meeting with Avient’s team can schedule appointments in advance with the media contact below.
